text: ["What are the distance‑ratio measurements obtained from the DESI BAO survey and how are they used to constrain cosmological parameters?","How does a dark QCD cosmology modify the expansion history and distance ratios compared to ΛCDM, and what impact does this have on the inferred value of the Hubble constant?","When the DESI BAO distance‑ratio data are combined with Planck CMB observations, how does the resulting constraint on the Hubble constant differ between a dark QCD model and a ΛCDM model, and what does this imply for the Hubble tension?"]
